title: Synthetic-data_Audit
summary: A collection of Jupyter notebooks generating and auditing synthetic tabular data on a breast cancer dataset, including membership-inference/Mahalanobis distance privacy assessments comparing multiple synthesizers. SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE, GaussianCopula) are run via sdv.single_table and evaluated with sdv.evaluation.single_table's evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic.
evidence: Cancer.ipynb:224-231 imports CTGANSynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and evaluate_quality from sdv.single_table/sdv.evaluation
